blocks.html: On August 3, as the public was first learning about Professor Jason Arday, then of the Cambridge Faculty of Education and Jesus College, Tyler Austin Harper posted a thread challenging the way elite institutions have approached the hiring and promotion of black scholars. In his view, the leaders of these schools frequently select mediocre academics for symbolically important “first-ever” positions, while passing over stronger candidates whose protected identities would serve just as well. “There are plenty of talented black academics, and these elite schools step over their bodies to elevate scrubs who either come from rich families ([Claudine] Gay) or who let them feel the warm glow of the white man’s burden (Arday).” In terms of its nominal purposes—to protect and improve the institution’s reputation and to find reasons for self-congratulation--it would seem
